course.title: Legal Basis of Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Write short notes on the following issues of designating a New Town according (20) to New Town Act, 1981 (Local Authority Oversight) Regulations 2018 (any two):
i) Stewardship and community involvement for sustainable new town development
ii) Considerations for the appointment of Board Members (LLNTDC)
iii) Groups associated with Government consultation iv) Documents necessary to attach with the proposal for designating new town and appointing oversight authority.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
